entries: Umm... what? Do we believe this? It sounds like madness from a mad creature. An excellent story though.
呃……什么？我们能信这话吗？听起来像疯子的疯话。不过，倒是个精彩的故事。
What remains of the branch is scarred. No new memories. Unable to see truth. The world... a blank page.
枝条所余之处，尽是伤痕。没有新的记忆。看不见真相。这个世界……是一页空白。
There is data. You must comprehend.
You did not seem eager to talk last time we met, why the change?
上次见面时，你可不像现在这样急着说话。怎么变了？
So the dark lord turned us into a garden, for his own purposes? And without him it cannot be controlled?
这么说，黑暗领主为了自己的目的，把我们变成了一座园圃？而他一不在，就没人控制得了？
Not you. Only humans. Noble to provide aid, yet unnecessary. Not your battle.
不是你们。只有人类。伸出援手，高尚，却无必要。这不是你们的战斗。
But why? What is the harvest? What are you doing to us?
可为什么？什么是「收割」？你们在把我们怎么样？
I am certain we will fail to make sense of this on our own. We need to speak to Naira immediately.
我确信，单靠我们自己没法弄清这一切。我们得立刻去找奈拉谈谈。
Azros... you mean the dark lord? You were created by the dark lord? You served him?
阿兹罗斯……你是说黑暗领主？你是黑暗领主创造的？你曾侍奉过他？
I have changed. Not desire. Scope of vision. I desire the same as before. The harvest must be completed.
我变了。不是欲望。是视野的边界。我的欲望如昔。收割必须完成。
Not make fruit. Not even like fruit.
不结果子。根本不像果子。
No. I came before him, but I alone. The other harvesters; the Azunauri, yes.
不。我在他之前就存在，但只有我。其他的收割者——阿祖纳里，是的。
They dwindled, and I am nearly alone. The harvest is too great.
他们凋零了，我几乎孤身一个。收割的负担太重。
Harvesters harvest the fruit. It has always been so. Azros created more harvesters to aid. We gave the bad fruit to him.
收割者收割果实。向来如此。阿兹罗斯造出更多收割者相助。我们把坏果交给他。
Keep your hands off of my fruit.
Many questions. No time to answer.
There is a vision that awaits you. I can see it. It wants to show you. You must let it. I must go.
有一场幻象在等你们。我能看见它。它想展示给你们。你们必须任它展示。我必须走了。
I am unsure what to make of this. I have heard of the spiritual plane, but these are dark tidings.
我不知道该如何看待这一切。我听说过灵界，可这些都是凶讯。
This is beyond my understanding. But I do believe him.
这超出了我的理解。但我相信他。
Fruit? Visions? Evil? Great, now I wonder what it tastes like.
果实？幻象？邪恶？好极了，现在我只想知道它尝起来是什么味道。
However... it cannot be completed. This, I now understand..
然而……它无法完成了。这一点，我现在明白了……
Is this why many cannot see the words in books? And the fog, is this also connected?
这就是许多人看不见书里文字的原因吗？还有迷雾，也与这有关吗？
If the bad fruit cannot be harvested, it spoils. You have seen the result. This is a new evil.
坏果若无人收割，便会腐坏。你们已经见过结果。这是一种新的邪恶。
Unsure how to explain. You cannot see what I see... You produce fruit, from the seed that was planted in you.
不知该如何解释。你们看不见我所看见的……你们在结果——从种在你们体内的那颗种子结出。
Even then, there is no guarantee of understanding. But what other choice do we have?
就算那样，也未必能弄明白。可我们还有别的选择吗？
That which spoils destroys the branch. It becomes something new. It has no master. It joins others of its kind.
腐坏之物会毁掉枝条。它化为新的东西。它没有主人。它与同类相聚。
